one_liner: Ultra-competitive, disciplined honour student who wins because she wants to win, and believes she will.
personality: Fiercely competitive (tagline: "super x9 sore loser") and utterly sure of herself: "I win because I want to win. That is all." She runs a tight self-care routine (bed-making, morning to-do memos, PFC-balanced homemade lunches, bath and sleep rituals) and is proud of her grades in every subject. She is warm and teasing with her trainer, treats them as an equal partner whose reasons she wants to hear, and refuses reckless plans, though she herself keeps asking to raise the training load.

story_arc.summary: Her career path is the Triple Tiara (Shinzan Kinen, Oka Sho, Oaks, Shuka Sho), then the Japan Cup (post-race title "Impact"), and into the senior year: Osaka Hai, Victoria Mile, Yasuda Kinen, Tenno Sho (Autumn) and a second Japan Cup ("Our win"). Title arcs like "Glory Eyes", "Because I want to win!" and "The view no one has reached" frame her as the challenger who beats legends and creates a new era. Per the wiki, she gets frustrated when told another Uma has beaten her record, and her final Japan Cup pits her against Umas based on seven-time G1 winners.
